en.lan.committed.pin.copy: The two computers now trust each other. Continue to confirm the displays and save the setup before testing.
en.lan.committed.wait.peer: Waiting for the other computer to confirm the write…
en.lan.cancelled.title: Pairing cancelled
en.lan.fail.title: Pairing did not finish
en.lan.error.rejected: The other computer cancelled this pairing.
en.lan.error.aborted: The connection dropped and pairing was aborted.
en.lan.error.timeout: Timed out. Make sure both computers are on the pairing screen and try again.
en.lan.error.onesided: The previous pairing completed on one side only and has been undone. Please pair again.
en.lan.error.commit: Writing the configuration failed. Please try again.
en.lan.error.record: An unfinished pairing record exists on this computer. Check diagnostics or pair again.
en.lan.error.interrupted: The previous pairing was interrupted during commit; this computer’s configuration is unchanged. Please pair again.
en.lan.error.not.confirmed: Invalid data arrived before both users confirmed; pairing was aborted.
en.lan.error.window: The other computer is not on its pairing screen. Start pairing on both computers at the same time.
en.lan.error.disconnected: The network connection dropped. Check both computers’ network and try again.
en.lan.error.busy: Another pairing is already in progress.
en.lan.error.address: The target address is not on the local network.
en.lan.error.network: The local-network connection failed. Check the network and try again.
en.lan.error.group.conflict: The other computer already belongs to another switch group. Unpair it there first.
en.lan.error.proto: The two KVMFlow versions are incompatible. Update both to the latest version and try again.
en.lan.confirm.ready.title: Confirm displays for {p0}
en.lan.confirm.ready.copy: This is what {p0} reported. Confirming syncs it to both computers.
en.lan.monitor.pending.copy: Use the monitor’s own buttons to switch its input to {p0} once; it updates automatically once read.
en.lan.confirm.mixed.later: Mixed-screen assignment can be finished later in Settings.
en.lan.try.title: Try it
en.lan.try.copy: Press the USB switch twice to confirm the keyboard, mouse and monitors switch over and back.
en.lan.try.first: Press once: keyboard, mouse and {p1} switch to {p0}
en.lan.try.failed.hint: The keyboard and mouse switched, but {p0} received no command: its input value may be wrong. Read it again or check the cables, then retry.
en.lan.secondary.wait.title: Waiting for the primary
en.lan.secondary.wait.copy: Press “Add another computer” in KVMFlow on the primary. The connection request will appear here.
en.lan.secondary.request: {p0} requests to connect. Confirm both computers show the same numbers
en.lan.secondary.resolving: The primary is finishing the configuration…
en.lan.secondary.done.title: Configured by {p0}
en.lan.secondary.done.copy: KVMFlow keeps running in the tray. Changes made on either computer sync automatically.
en.lan.secondary.done.pending: {p0} has not read this computer’s input value yet. Switch it to this computer once using the monitor’s buttons.
en.lan.log.input.learned.copy: A monitor’s input value was read automatically.
en.lan.log.trigger.verified.copy: The secondary confirmed the USB switch works.
en.lan.try.failed.title: Test switch failed
en.lan.try.failed.copy: Some monitors did not switch. Check the input values and cables.
en.lan.error.local.setup: Identify the USB switch and read this computer’s monitor inputs before pairing.
en.lan.error.identity: Could not read this computer’s identity. Check local networking and retry.
en.lan.error.config.refresh: Could not load the latest paired configuration. Retry before saving settings.
en.lan.error.window.close: Could not close the pairing window. Retry or quit the app.
en.lan.alias.question: Are these the same physical monitor?
en.lan.alias.copy: Confirm to match these monitors. Choose “Different monitors” when they are not the same display; pairing still completes and configuration merges later in Settings.
en.lan.replacement.question: Replace the offline {p0} with {p1}?
en.lan.replacement.keep: Keep the old computer and add this one
en.lan.resolve.unsupported: This choice needs a newer KVMFlow. Cancel pairing and update both computers.
en.lan.profile.waiting: Waiting for the secondary’s monitor report
en.lan.profile.waiting.copy: The connection is ready. Continue once the secondary reports its monitors.
en.lan.try.evidence.pending: Waiting for both computers’ evidence. Check the actual monitor picture too.
en.lan.try.error: The switching test did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
en.lan.alias.different.hint: Keep it unmatched; pairing still completes and you can match it in Settings
en.compat.prepare.failed: Could not prepare the device report. Try again.
en.compat.paste: The report is too long for a link and has been copied. Paste it into the device report field on GitHub before submitting.
en.feedback.title: Feedback
en.feedback.rate: Too many requests. Try again later.
en.feedback.large: The feedback is too large. Shorten the text or exclude diagnostics.
en.feedback.invalid: Check your feedback and try again.
en.feedback.diagnostics.failed: Could not collect diagnostics. Try again or uncheck the option.
en.lan.error.id.conflict: Another computer is using the same device identity. Update KVMFlow on both computers, then pair again.
en.lan.error.id.migration: This legacy identity is already paired. Remove the old pairing on both computers, then pair again.
en.lan.error.identity.io: Could not save this computer’s identity. Check write access to the configuration folder and restart KVMFlow.
en.lan.error.topology.self: The shared setup is missing this computer. Repair is in progress. If it does not recover, add this computer again on the primary.
en.lan.error.config.save: The setup could not be saved. Retry before testing.
en.lan.error.setup.pending: The display setup is not saved yet. Show the secondary on each monitor, then retry reading its inputs before testing.
en.v2.start.title: Start setup
en.v2.start.copy: Make sure your keyboard and mouse are connected to the USB switch.
en.v2.wait.title: Switch to the other computer
en.v2.wait.open: Open KVMFlow on the other computer
en.v2.done.title: Both computers are paired
en.v2.connect.title: Connect another computer
en.v2.select.copy: Multiple computers found. Select one to pair.
en.v2.pending.copy: Use the monitor buttons to switch to this computer.
en.v2.test.title: Test switching
en.v2.test.copy: Press the USB switch to switch to {p0}.
en.v2.test.hint: If the monitors did not switch, switch to {p0} manually.
en.v2.ip.open: KVMFlow is open on the other computer
en.v2.ip.network: Both computers are on the same network
en.v2.ip.hint: The IP address appears on the other computer’s waiting page.
en.v2.error.title: Pairing failed
en.v2.error.copy: The connection was interrupted. Check that your firewall allows KVMFlow to access the network.
en.v2.test.error.copy: {p0} did not respond to the switch command. Enable DDC/CI in the monitor menu.
en.v2.ddc: Enable DDC/CI in the monitor menu.
en.v2.read.title: Cannot read monitor
